name: ATM Diagnostic Response V 02
definition: The ATMDiagnosticResponse message is sent by an acquirer to an ATM in response to an ATMDiagnosticRequest message ensuring the availability and the validity of the parameters.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDiagnosticResponse.name: ATM Diagnostic Response
ATMDiagnosticResponse.definition: Information related to the response of a diagnostic from an ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
